results.name: Offline home opens with 250 archetypes and 1000 visual variants
Seven scenes and all character groups are available; 1000 portraits are visually distinct
500 residents start with many activities and a three-minute limit; search has no visible UI
Keyboard zoom, drag, reset and pause keep the screen clear
Photo pixels omit every other person and reveal nothing when the target is outside the crop
Wrong taps cost three seconds; three photos each develop after three seconds and capture the selected region
All seven scenes retain 500 agents, 500 looks, and a full-viewport world
Browser timer expires at three minutes and restart resets the game
Portrait mobile search fills the viewport and supports pinch zoom without buttons
Mobile camera supports choosing a frame, taking a photo, and returning to the live town
Two-finger hold opens pause and target reference on mobile
